name: Provost cutter
text: A Provost cutter is working the lanes, checking every transponder it meets.

choices.label: Show your transponder
choices.result: The corvette checks your transponder against the Fleet's lists, finds a friend of the Fleet, and waves you on without a search.

outcomes.result: The engines hold, and the ship outruns them. Every band heard the chase.
They close before the engines can open the gap.
